patch.value: Three shell-scope and quoting fail-opens attest unproven npm publishes

The canonical publish-attestation auditor passes three executed counterexamples: unset inside an if is forgotten after block close, single-quoted or backslash-escaped variable references are expanded, and bindings leak between independent npm script shells.

Conditional unset survives the auditor block close conservatively; Single-quoted and backslash-escaped scalar and array references do not expand; Each package script is analyzed in an independent shell scope; Required pass/fail behavior and 22-repo fleet non-regression are verified

Execute auditPublishAttestation at ca78aa9 against: FLAG=--provenance followed by conditional unset and npm publish dollar-FLAG; npm publish with a single-quoted dollar-FLAG or escaped dollar-FLAG; and package scripts setup=FLAG=--provenance plus release=npm publish dollar-FLAG. Each reports failures: [].
All three unprovable publishes are refused while established straight-line and same-arm attested publishes continue to pass.
Each reproduced input reports no failures and attests an npm publish that lacks runtime provenance.
An unattested package publish can satisfy the release attestation gate.
